profile.title: Professional Profile
profile.content: I am a Senior Backend Developer with over 7 years of experience, specializing in high-growth startups, international environments, and technologically demanding projects. I have demonstrated my ability to build and scale robust backend systems from scratch, managing platforms with over 10 million registered users. I am an expert in designing and implementing native cloud architectures (GCP), microservices, CI/CD deployments (Docker, GitHub Actions), and integrating automations (Zapier, Make). I consider myself a pioneer in the practical application and customization of Generative AI (Stable Diffusion, LoRA training, video models), the construction of AI agents and working with LLMs (Langchain), combining these techniques with tools like Photoshop to create high-quality, consistent visual content, enhancing brand presence and engagement. I am characterized by my rapid adaptability, continuous learning, and proactive approach to integrating AI solutions into development processes.
profile.aiAgents: construction of AI agents and working with LLMs (Langchain)

yana.title: Yana – Mexico (Remote)
yana.positionValue: Backend Developer & Founding Technical Team Member
yana.desc1: As a founding technical team member (initially 2 backend devs), I actively participated in scaling the platform to support over 10 million users, including the creation of AI Agents using LLMs and natural language processing (NLP) technologies.
yana.desc2: Developed and optimized key RESTful APIs (JSON) for the main conversational application, ensuring efficient handling of high traffic volumes.
yana.desc3: Participated in the strategic migration of the infrastructure to GCP and in the implementation of Docker and CI/CD with GitHub Actions, contributing to significant improvements in scalability, response time, and security.
yana.desc4: Configured and managed the mass segmented email sending system (+10k) using AWS SES.
yana.desc5: Contributed to the design and implementation of an automatically scalable microservices architecture, enabling modular development and independent deployments.
yana.desc6: Worked effectively under the Scrum methodology, collaborating closely with frontend, QA, and product teams.

I have also explored the creation of AI Agents with LLMs (Langchain).
